Run a bundled shadshiny example app

Source: R/page.R
shad_run_example.Rd

Run a bundled shadshiny example app

Usage

shad_run_example(example = "kitchen-sink")

Arguments

example

Example app directory name under inst/examples. One of:

"kitchen-sink"

(default) the full R-built demo of every component.

"00-static-parity"

hand-written anatomy reference, for visual parity checks.

"01-auth-onboarding"

sign-in / create-account flow with a 4-step onboarding wizard, 2FA (input-OTP) and social sign-in.

"02-analytics-dashboard"

admin console: sidebar, menubar, command palette, KPI cards, resizable chart split and a searchable team directory.

"03-support-chat"

support inbox with a stick-to-bottom transcript, quick replies, attachment popover and a simulated assistant.

"04-storefront"

product page: carousel, variant pickers, add-to-cart sheet, tabbed details and reviews pagination.

"05-settings-profile"

account settings with live theming, availability checks, 2FA and destructive alert-dialogs.

"06-docs-reader"

documentation site: sidebar nav, ⌘K search, resizable article/TOC split, rich typography and tabbed code examples.

"07-data-explorer"

shad_data_table() with KPI value boxes and theme-following plots.

"08-llm-chat"

streaming shad_chat_server(); swap the handler for an ellmer stream to go live.

"09-app-shell"

shad_page_sidebar() with the layout primitives, sparklines, a ⌘K palette that drives navigation, and dialogs built in the server.

The numbered apps are real-world examples that together exercise the whole component library.

Value

Called for its side effect (launches a Shiny app).

See also

Other shadshiny utilities: shad_icon(), shad_icon_names(), shad_icon_raw(), shadshiny_deps()
